In all four examples
(@exr-derive-bernoulli-score, @exr-pois-score-fn,
@exr-gauss-score-fn, and @exr-exp-score-fn),
the score function with respect to the mean turned out to be:

$$\score = \scoreexpf$$

::: notes
This pattern is no coincidence.
All four distributions belong to the
[exponential family](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exponential_family)
of probability distributions,
whose members share many special properties
[@hoggtanis2015, Section 6.7; @dobson4e, Chapter 3].
:::
